name: Languages of Elysium
summary: Language families, the Concordial contact language, Charter language guarantees, scripts, and belief distribution.

totals.officialLanguageNote: The Concord has no official language. Concordial is a working language only.

families.name: Alcyonic
families.summary: Descended from the flow-share administrative language; oldest written tradition on Elysium.

families.name: Elandric
families.summary: Largest family by native speakers; deep tonal system.

families.name: Thalassic
families.summary: Maritime family with exceptionally precise sea vocabulary.

families.name: Boreal-Vail
families.summary: Heavily agglutinative; the language family of early industry.

families.name: Serranic
families.summary: Storm-coast languages, commonly bilingual with Elandric.

families.name: Isle tongues
families.summary: Nine related languages with a rich navigational lexicon.

concordial.name: Concordial
concordial.summary: Contact language descended from the Long Reach maritime pidgin; the Concord's working language, belonging to no region.
concordial.originNote: Creolized in port cities over six centuries following the Long Reach; standardized by the Concord in EY 6.

charterGuarantees.name: Right to be governed in your own language
charterGuarantees.summary: Any resident may deal with any organ of the Concord in any registered language and receive binding response in the same.

charterGuarantees.name: Equal authenticity
charterGuarantees.summary: Legislation is drafted simultaneously in all 41 registered languages, all equally authoritative; no version is the original.

charterGuarantees.name: No language may be a condition of a right
charterGuarantees.summary: Civil service, education, and eligibility for office cannot require any specific language.

scripts.name: Alcyonic syllabary
scripts.summary: Oldest script on Elysium; in continuous use since 4,900 BE.

civicVirtues.name: Candour
civicVirtues.summary: Say what is true, especially when it is against you; the corresponding vice is presentation, not lying.

civicVirtues.name: Stewardship
civicVirtues.summary: You hold things in trust for those who cannot argue with you: the dead, the unborn, the biosphere.

civicVirtues.name: Redundancy
civicVirtues.summary: Anything that matters should have a second way of working; an engineering principle that became a moral one.

civicVirtues.name: Restraint
civicVirtues.summary: Capacity is not a reason. The Concord's answer to power without aggression.

civicVirtues.name: Repair
civicVirtues.summary: Nothing is finished; everything is maintained. The era is named the Long Maintenance with pride.

belief.name: No affiliation
belief.summary: Secular, philosophical, or indifferent; many still keep Alcyonic ancestral observances.

belief.name: Stewardship traditions
belief.summary: Largest organised family of belief and mostly non-theistic; rooted in Isle ocean stewardship. Central observance is a public accounting of what one has taken and returned.

belief.name: Theistic traditions
belief.summary: Diverse and regional; declined since the founding without suppression, a live source of grievance.

belief.name: Alcyonic ancestral practice
belief.summary: Continuous lineage-and-memory tradition of the Alcyon basin, tied to the flow-share and the ruins of Ilvaret.

observances.name: The Naming
observances.summary: First day of Aumar; communities read aloud their own local dead from the Long Emergency. No speeches; officials attend but do not speak.

observances.name: Thresholdday
observances.summary: The intercalary day; the Concord's only universal holiday. No work, courts, markets, or scheduled governance.

dailyRhythm.name: First waking
dailyRhythm.summary: Dawn to early afternoon; most formal work, schooling, and institutional business.

dailyRhythm.name: The Stillness
dailyRhythm.summary: Early-afternoon rest of about 1.5 civil hours; commerce pauses and cities fall quiet. Protected by labour law.

dailyRhythm.name: Second waking
dailyRhythm.summary: Mid-afternoon to late night; the longer half, and where most social, family, artistic, and civic life happens.
